confidence_notes: The FX rate is the RBA figure for 18 Nov 2026. I ran one search for food and drink prices, and the sources disagreed. Cheap meals were about US$3-5, cappuccino about US$3, beer about US$2-4 and cocktails about US$10. The cocktail figure came from a single budget guide. Wine by the glass was inferred from bottle prices of about US$6-9 and from Lima's usual price relationship to beer, so it is uncertain. The mid-range meal for two combines a low aggregated figure (about US$11) with a higher budget-guide figure (about US$20), and I chose a figure between them. Accommodation anchors are holistic estimates from general knowledge. I did not search for or inspect any accommodation listings.
comparable_city_reasoning: I based the food and drink anchors on aggregated Lima price data. I based the accommodation anchors on typical Miraflores and Barranco tourist-area pricing, and on comparison with Bogota and Quito.
